command: SELECT Timestamp, ResourceAttributes['host.name'] AS host, Body FROM external.otel_logs WHERE ResourceAttributes['network']='glamsterdam-msf-2' AND Timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-12 23:24:13') AND Timestamp < toDateTime('2026-10-13 08:30:00') AND Body LIKE '%OutOfMemoryError%' ORDER BY Timestamp LIMIT 40
